text:
jamie_ae: Quick thread  Acme wants to close the POC this week. Procurement told our AE they can wire immediately but procurement legal prefers DocuSign. Can legal confirm if we can accept wire before countersign?

maria_legal: Short answer: no raw wire without controls. We accept wiring only after countersigned MSA+Order Form OR a valid PO that includes explicit wiring authorization, buyer tax ID, and approval for amounts >$250k. If they insist on wire-first, we need an exec email approval and a holdback clause until countersign.

noah_finance: For wiring we need a clear PO payload to match bank instructions. Example minimal PO fields we require: PO number, billing entity, tax ID, amount, PO issue date, wiring authorization statement. Anything missing will block AP.

lina_se: From engineering: POC requires Dedicated pool + KMS attestation. We can provide attestation PDF and runtime isolation notes. Customer-managed HSM supported but onboarding is 2-3 weeks and may be delayed if they pay before sign.

maria_legal: I'm preparing a short redline for the Order Form and the DPA: allow electronic signatures via DocuSign/Adobe, wire allowed only post-countersign or with a specific PO. KMS wording will shift to "reasonable evidence of key control". Also tightening subprocessor notification windows.

jamie_ae: They counter-proposed: "we can wire today to speed things up". Can sales offer a compromise? Maybe accept escrow of funds or escrow-style holdback?

maria_legal: Compromise idea: accept wire to our escrow account with funds released after countersign OR accept wire with a 10% holdback released upon countersign. Need ops/finance sign-off on escrow flow. Also need buyer exec email as proof of authorization.

noah_finance: Escrow requires legal review and banking setup; not trivial to do same-day. Holdback on wire is more feasible: finance can accept a wire with a funds-hold instruction in the remittance notes and an email confirmation from buyer exec. We'll need PO mapping to invoice to avoid reconciliation issues.

lina_se: Security questionnaire deadline is EOW. I will fill KMS/HSM and isolation answers and attach the attestation. Note: HSM onboarding depends on contract and billing confirmation; if they wire first without countersign we risk delaying HSM provisioning.

maria_legal: SLA ask from Acme: they want a 30% single-incident credit for >1hr downtime. Our standard: monthly cap 25%, per-incident cap 10%. Recommend we hold firm. Draft clause: "Service credits up to 25% of monthly charges; per-incident credits capped at 10%. Uptime measured via Redwood telemetry; calculation described in SLA schedule." Also add exclusions for customer misconfiguration and force majeure.

jamie_ae: Can someone paste a sample PO body for procurement? They keep asking for exact fields for AP.

noah_finance: Sample PO payload (send this to procurement):
```
po_number: PO-ACME-2024-1104
amount: 120000.00
currency: USD
tax_id: 12-3456789
bill_to: Redwood Inference LLC
wiring_authorization: "Buyer authorizes wire to Redwood account ACH/ABA xxxxx. Funds conditioned on countersigned MSA/DPA or buyer exec email confirming authorization."
notes: "Attach countersigned MSA or reference countersign workflow"
```

docu-bot: Drive upload complete  orderform_v5.pdf and msa_dpa_redline_v3.docx at https://redwood.co/drive/acme-poc (perms: sales,legal,finance)

maria_legal: I'll drop the redline and a one-page PO/Wire FAQ into drive and call out required PO fields and the wet-ink fallback (mailing address, signatory name/title, original document retention). Recommend we push DocuSign to keep this week timeline.

jamie_ae: I'll push procurement with the PO template and propose DocuSign as the fastest path. Tagging @maria_legal and @lina_se for the attestation and redline. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
